requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Reduce the number of unique product names (references) displayed to the customer for the HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 series on 123.hp.com to a single, consistent reference name.
requirements.Additional_Comments: Is there a reason to have 3 names for the same reference? HP OJP 9010 All-in-one Printer series, HP OJP 9010e All-in-One Printer series, HP OJP 9010 All-in-One Printer. Having too many names isn't efficient and can induce user errors. Currently 4 references for Office Jet Pro 9010. Design target: Only one name/reference is proposed to customer.
requirements.Threshold: Two names/reference are proposed. Currently 4 references for Office Jet Pro 9010.
requirements.Goal: Only one name/reference is proposed to customer.
requirements.Remarks: Quality team is following-up with Tais Bellini. 20210702 (Chris/Jess) Not possible to change in 123.hp.com as it references Product Master List where it is common shared with PC group. Only possible to do at support.hp.com. Proposed to Drop.

requirements.Requirement: Printer able to run all new/current EM / market segment media
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must successfully print on all new and current EM (Evaluation Media) and market segment media types, meeting intervention specifications for different media and climatic conditions on the Manhattan platform.
requirements.Additional_Comments: Printer to meet intervention spec for the different media and climatic conditions for Manhattan platform.
requirements.Threshold: Minimum PQ (Print Quality) acceptable by region.
requirements.Goal: Pass intervention rate and NO PQ issue.
requirements.Remarks: 20220920(Sau Pin): LP2 Life test are meeting Intervention rate(Qual). 20220316 (Sau Pin): Baseline is assumed to be same as Manhattan. Status as 'Yellow' as need to review intervention performance. Accept threshold. EM media as Eval media.

requirements.Requirement: Product can be placed and work on uneven surface ( sofa , table cloth , carpet …)
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must function properly and without component failure when placed and operated on uneven surfaces, such as sofas, table cloths, or carpets.
requirements.Additional_Comments: As the complaint on Vasari, input tray sensor flag broken when printer is placed on uneven surface, this issue should be fixed in new product.
requirements.Remarks: 20220315(Sau Pin): Marconi Base LP1 test with no issue reported. Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going. HDRV response: Have conducted sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi and Agave. Only Malbec Hi had issue with input tray flag broken. Need TME input on field data for 3M. Aiqiang: Manhattan field data shows tray 'fang' broken. ME will look at solutions to solve fang broken issue such as to strengthen the fang.

requirements.Requirement: Tilt left and right each while printing
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Evaluate printer functional performance when tilted 20 degrees left and right during printing, and confirm no functional failure occurs.
requirements.Additional_Comments: To assess whether there is any functional failure if customer tilt the printer during printing. (Sayan tilt left and right each at 20 degree while printing)
requirements.Remarks: Tilt 20 degree is for CISS product as acknowledged by Michelle. Shin to check if want to evaluate on Manhattan Plus with XXL ink cartridges. Close for Marconi.

requirements.Requirement: Put printer on trolley and print
requirements.Cleaned_Requirement_Text: Printer must maintain print quality and function correctly when operated on a trolley.
requirements.Additional_Comments: To check if there is PQ issue when printer print on trolley.
requirements.Remarks: (Sau Pin): Marconi Base LP1 test with no issue reported. Marconi Hi and PDL SKUs testing on-going. Interesting to find out the test result. HDRV response: Have conducted sanity check with Manhattan Base & Hi, Malbec Hi and Agave. No issue found. Agree to put it as evaluation. To be consistent with standard UBT requirement.20220315
